body_lead: NTT DATA, a leading IT services company, and Neysa Networks, an AI-first cloud platform company, on Friday signed a tripartite Memorandum of Understanding with the Telangana government to establish an AI Data Centre Cluster in Hyderabad, with an investment of Rs 10,500 crore. The MoU was signed in the presence of Chief Minister A Revanth Reddy during his ongoing visit to Japan. Senior leadership from Tokyo-headquartered NTT DATA and Neysa Networks participated in the signing ceremony.
